description: This file defines the SnapshotStreamingActor class, an Akka actor responsible for streaming snapshot data from a MongoDB-backed persistence journal. It manages creating sources of snapshots, mapping snapshots to domain entities, and handling streaming lifecycle events.

classes.name: SnapshotStreamingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that streams snapshots from MongoDB on request, supporting both production and testing configurations.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for instantiating SnapshotStreamingActor with specified PID-to-EntityId mappings.

methods.name: propsForTest
methods.description: Creates Props for testing purposes with mocked MongoDB components.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Closes the MongoDB client when the actor stops.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling, primarily starting snapshot streaming or logging unexpected messages.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates an Akka Stream source of snapshots based on the received command.

methods.name: mapSnapshot
methods.description: Converts a raw MongoDB Document into a StreamedSnapshot object, maps entity ID, and cleans up the document.

methods.name: startStreaming
methods.description: Initiates the streaming process and sends back a stream reference.
